# Agent Looper (`@dancingteeth/agent-looper`)

> Repo-agnostic fix-until-green harness: frozen GOAL → worker agent → shell verify → optional judge/reviewGate. Fresh context every iteration. Progress lives in git/files.

## For coding agents

Start here:

- README.intro.md — product spine (worker / verify / judge / human)
- ARCHITECTURE.md — loop engine, escalation, cache-friendly prompts
- AGENTS.md — working agreements for this repo
- CHANGELOG.md — shipped versions (current: 0.5.0)
- SECURITY.md — vulnerability reporting
- docs/embed-api.md — library embed contract (stable vs experimental, frozen shapes)
- docs/claude-runtime.md — PATH `claude -p --safe-mode` worker/judge
- docs/verification-as-skill.md — measurable verify.sh + VERIFY.skill.md
- docs/unknowns-preflight.md — remove unknowns before freezing GOAL
- docs/runtime-map.md — worker/judge cost presets
- docs/runtime-cost-bench.md — same-task runtime cost method (n≥3, change one variable)
- docs/cursor-auto-router.md — Auto/Router opt-in blocked until SDK logs routed model id
- docs/loop-review-roadmap.md — M1–M10 + 0.5.0 prompt/Claude/embed

## Non-negotiables

1. Shell `verify` / `finalVerify` exit 0 is the only completion truth (not LLM self-assessment).
2. Do not edit GOAL.md mid-loop.
3. Fresh worker session each iteration (Ralph): no accumulating chat memory as the product.
4. reviewGate is optional and only re-opens on gating findings (error + impact), never replaces verify.
5. Taskwarrior: UUID only (`taskwarriorUuid`), never numeric ID alone.
6. Result `status`: `done` | `continue` | `waiting` (HITL). Guide packets structure reviewGate re-entry.

## Quick run (Cursor dogfood)

```bash
agent-loop-init
# or: agent-loop-prompt --out .cursor/loops/my-task
# edit .cursor/agent-loop.repo.json, GOAL.md, loop.json, verify.sh
export CURSOR_API_KEY=…
agent-loop run .cursor/loops/my-task --runtime cursor --review-gate
```

Worker default: composer-2.5. Judge default: grok-4.6 (`reviewModel`). `runtime: claude` needs Claude Code 2.1.169+ (`claude login`).

npm: `@dancingteeth/agent-looper` **0.5.0**. Layout: src/loop, src/review, src/agents, templates, .cursor/loops. Embed: docs/embed-api.md. Security: SECURITY.md.
